answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Butcher apprenticeship certificate with trade guild attestation makes the industry visible: three-year apprenticeship, 4,000 supervised hours, practical exam, guild dues. The glacier is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the summit is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The sparrow is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
